## Activity

During October 2024, Market Eye Clinic recorded 371 captures. Activity was completed in line with the planned operating arrangements. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The available activity indicates that the clinic continued to provide a regular capture service during the reporting period.

## Image quality

Of the 371 captures, 69 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 18.6 per cent. This remains an important consideration for service monitoring, as images that cannot be graded do not provide a result for clinical review. The reported image-quality position should therefore be considered alongside the overall capture activity for Market Eye Clinic.

## Grading

There were 105 referable results during October 2024. The median lag for grading was 2 days. These results and the grading turnaround provide the principal operational measures for the reporting period. Overall, the activity recorded at Market Eye Clinic was accompanied by a measurable level of ungradable images and a defined grading workload, with session lists operating as planned apart from routine leave.
